sentence: The sports centre can lend you any of the equipment you need.
synonym: give you whatever tools you require
synonymNote: 意思相同，都表示提供所需的器材或工具。

distractors.word: sell you all the equipment you want
distractors.note: sell是出售，不是借用，意思不同。

distractors.word: show you how to use the equipment
distractors.note: show是展示使用方法，不是借出器材。

distractors.word: keep any of the equipment for you
distractors.note: keep是为你保管，不是借给你使用。
